_comment: Every number here is a placeholder chosen to be defensible, not a settled
pre-registration value. They are frozen at build phase E3, at which point
'provisional' becomes false and 'frozen_at' carries the freeze date. Until
then every gate report echoes these values along with provisional=true, so no
artefact can be mistaken for one produced under pre-registered thresholds.

The eta-gap thresholds are in POOL-STANDARDIZED quality-score units, not
Cohen's d. The gaps are already divided by the spread of item scores, so a
second standardization by the within-size spread of gaps would penalise
exactly the tightly controlled designs §6.3 is asking for.
